simple.summary: עֵת קָצִין (ʻÊth Qâtsîyn) means Eth-Katsin , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 13.

definitions.full: H6278. Eth Qatsin קָצִין [ עֵה ] proper name, of a location on border of Zebulun, only with ה locative, ק ׳עִתָּה Josh 19:13 site unknown.
